exclusions: All image/output/mask buffer overlap and alias-converted output scenarios outside this bounded increment; no upstream overlap probes.
Undersized mask/output buffers,zero-depth output and fabricated unsafe striding are excluded because Cython bounds/wrap/none checks are disabled.
Arbitrary ndarray subclass/custom array/scalar protocol hooks,memmap callbacks and caller error-policy callbacks are not exhaustively assessed.
No native implementation,registration,worker speedup or performance claim. Unsupported native paths must not be credited via upstream forwarding.

fixture_helpers.scope: Reuse qualified construction/descriptions only; frozen R1/R2 source and assertions unchanged.

autolevel.default_output: prepared image dtype; supplied supported fused out dtype/state is separately frozen
autolevel.footprint: required; Python missing-argument error precedes preprocessing
autolevel.formula: Nonempty: local imin/imax over included samples; delta=imax-imin. delta>0: signed Py_ssize_t numerator=(n_bins-1)*(g-imin), C integer division by delta truncates toward zero EVEN for floating output. Else0. Unsigned output conversion may wrap for excluded-center g outside local range.
autolevel.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)
autolevel.wide_arithmetic: Masked uint16 centers outside a unit-span local range produce signed quotients beyond +/-2**31; float32/64 output makes this observable. Do not use signed32 multiply/divide or cvtt-to-int32 intermediates.

enhance_contrast.default_output: prepared image dtype; supplied supported fused out dtype/state is separately frozen
enhance_contrast.footprint: required; Python missing-argument error precedes preprocessing
enhance_contrast.formula: Nonempty: imax if imax-g < g-imin, otherwise imin (LOWER wins exact midpoint tie). Empty0.
enhance_contrast.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

equalize.default_output: prepared image dtype; supplied supported fused out dtype/state is separately frozen
equalize.footprint: required; Python missing-argument error precedes preprocessing
equalize.formula: Nonempty: inclusive ascending-bin cumulative count through bin g, integer product (n_bins-1)*cdf_count divided by double pop, then output cast. Do not subtract CDF minimum or reassociate product/division. Empty0.
equalize.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

threshold.default_output: prepared image dtype; supplied supported fused out dtype/state is separately frozen
threshold.footprint: required; Python missing-argument error precedes preprocessing
threshold.formula: Nonempty: ascending-bin integer sum(histo[i]*i), mean=sum/double pop; output is strict g>mean, cast0 or1 (not255/65535). Equality and empty windows yield0.
threshold.signature: (image, footprint, out=None, mask=None, shift_x=0, shift_y=0, shift_z=0)

histogram_policy.bins: uint8:256; uint16:max(3,global image maximum)+1 after ordinary preparation, independent of mask/local minmax
histogram_policy.mask: Included neighbor samples only; output is computed even where center mask is zero. Bounds clip neighborhoods; zero footprint/mask yields population0.
histogram_policy.output: Frozen shape/strides/ownership/writeability/alias states, supplied output validation and partial mutation. Safe one/two-channel/oversized outputs retained; unsafe extents excluded.

interface_proposal.layout: Existing RankView and owned workspaces unchanged; explicit new operation capability bits required.
interface_proposal.simd: Reuse min/max,rolling count/sum and prefix-count state; vectorize exact final comparisons/casts where valid, retain source integer division and double product-before-division. Runtime AVX2 plus portable and optional shared global workers; no native-file ownership granted yet.
